pages.name: Sicilian: Grand Prix, Tal Defence, 3.e5
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the knight ...Nge7-g6 through Black's own e7-pawn. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling in the overview.

pages.notes: Plan 1 used a 'semi-open' f-file that White's f4-pawn closes and wrote castling as 0-0; plan 2 ignored the check. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling in plan 3.

pages.notes: Plan 3 named d6 and f7 as weak pawns (d6 is a square, the pawn is on d7); plan 1 called the d-file open. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Alapin Variation, Barmen Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed a knight to c3, where White's pawn stands; plan 2 wrote the queen retreats as bare squares. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Alapin Variation, Barmen Defense, Endgame Variation
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 gave White a d4-pawn that Black has just taken and missed that Black is a pawn up and threatens ...Nc2+ and ...Nxf3+; plan 2 attacked a 'weak d4-pawn' (it is Black's knight). Rewrote overview and plans 1, 2, 4. Plan 3 (Nb1-d2-b3, with the knight already on c3) is fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-7 (reviewer: first draft's Be3/Bb5+ do not chase the knight).

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Heidenfeld Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 pressed a d6-pawn that isn't there. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...d5
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote the d4-d5 break from a position where the d-pawn is still on d2. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Alapin, 2...d5 3.exd5 Qxd5 4.d4 cxd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 used d5 as White's outpost (it is in front of White's isolated pawn); plan 3 broke with e5 when White has no e-pawn; plan 2 blockaded with ...Nf6. Rewrote plans 1-3.
